description: Find which artist on Deezer (and Apple Music) is this artist, to bring their released records in: the confirmed one, or candidates to show the artist. A link to their music (Deezer, Spotify or Apple, artist or record) searches from that instead of the name.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

link.description: Optional: a link to the artist's music.

name: find_my_music
title: Find the artist's released music
